title: Missing UFO footage sparks mystery: Where are Pentagon’s alleged Colorado Triangle clips?
description: Two alleged military recordings from 2023 have resurfaced as a mystery after officials admitted they are trying to determine where the footage went. Pentagon Press Secretary Joel Valdez confirmed that officials are looking into the matter, saying the department was “actively investigating" the whereabouts of the videos.
